title: AIRLOCK
height: walls 2.8 m, low dome rising 0.6 m, beacon on top, porch over the outer door
doors: INNER DOOR (to the hub, sinks into the floor)
OUTER DOOR (to the regolith, sinks into the floor)
notes: Size and doors from the game (module_floors.gd 4 x 5, corners 0.6; module_doors.gd north and south; airlock.gd doors sink 2.8 m, ramp 2.5 m at 20 degrees).

Pieces in the game: SuitLocker with a suit and hose reel, InnerDoor, OuterDoor, the chamber, fan units, gauges, keypads (airlock.tscn). The suit-up bench and the dust brush come from the 2026-10-03 fit-out brief.
One airlock look everywhere (CONTEXT.md); the hub side of the inner door is the hub's striped airlock hatch.

concept.read: the concept K02 read element by element in the inventory's concept_elements (data/inventory/airlock.json), each element mapped to its rows or dropped with its reason; the ramp, dropped there before, is its row outer_ramp here

N.why: the inner door opens straight onto the hub's airlock door (its facet at 330 degrees): the base's modules (data/definitions/base.json) stand the airlock on the hub's seat with its north wall against that facet; its leaf (inventory door_leaf) sinks into the floor to open; the record stands no leaf here: the airlock's cycle (its motion) copies the outer door's leaf here, sunk open while the chamber holds air

S.why: the outer door opens onto the ramp (inventory outer_ramp) down to the Moon's regolith round the base; its leaf (inventory door_leaf) sinks into the floor
